differences.what: Wound care is a Medical note type.
WOUND 1, WOUND 2 and + ADD WOUND are the entries of the Wound section, which repeats, up to 10, each titled Wound {n}.
differences.why: inventory construct 22; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the most wounds in one note

differences.what: Location is a body region: a region of the shared list body_region (the eight of the quick form: Head, Upper Body, Abdomen, Back, Arms, Legs, Lower Body, Hands, added), a side of the shared list side (Right, Left, Bilateral, added) and a surface (Anterior, Posterior, added).
FRONT BACK is the region's surface: Anterior or Posterior.

Wound type is choose-one from the shared list wound_type: Ulcer is replaced by Venous and Arterial (added), and Cellulitis is added (Oct 19). Other asks for a short text. An abscess with surrounding cellulitis is typed as one of the two.
differences.why: inventory A1, A2, A28; PRD main 103, 410; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): choose-one or choose-many, with the quick form's twin

differences.what: Choose-one. The codes under_1_wk, wk_1_to_4, mo_1_to_3 and over_3_mo are given: the rule makes no code that starts with a letter from these labels.
Length, width and depth in cm with one decimal, typed in cm or inches and stored in cm, in one row: length and width 0.1 to 100, depth 0 to 30. Unable to Measure is a flag that clears the three.
differences.why: PRD main 411; inventory A29, construct 15; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the ranges

differences.what: Choose-many. Other asks for a short text.
Amount is choose-one from the shared list drainage_amount, whose label is Moderate (added): Mod is the same answer.
differences.why: inventory section 5 (drainage amount), A63; PRD main 410

differences.what: Type is choose-one, and shows only when Amount is Scant, Small, Moderate or Large.
Choose-many. No option is exclusive.
Choose-one. Urgent shows Go to Red flags and disposition, which opens the visit's Red flags note.
+ SHOW INFECTION DETAILS is a group that stays closed until tapped, always there. It does not open by itself for Possible, Yes and Urgent: the format has no condition for a group's opening.
differences.why: inventory A31 (a departure: forms 2.2 has collapsed and no condition for it)

differences.what: Choose-many. Fever and Chills stay in both rows.
Choose-many. None is exclusive. Other asks for a short text.
WOUND TREATMENT is a group, Wound treatment, inside the repeating Wound section: each wound has its own cleansing, procedure, dressing, medication, photos and follow-up.
differences.why: inventory A26 (the treatment is recorded for each wound): one piece holds both subsections, so the treatment sits in the entry

differences.what: Choose-many. None is exclusive.
Choose-many. None is exclusive.
Choose-many from the shared list dressing. Other asks for a short text.
Choose-many. None is exclusive. The answer is recorded; the order is placed in Orders.
TAKE WOUND PHOTO is a photo field, up to 5, a placeholder until phase 8. Its three buttons are the capture flow, not options.

Choose-one. The codes days_2_to_3 and week_1 are given: the rule makes no code that starts with a letter from these labels. The row mixes times and places, so Wound clinic in 1 week is one or the other.
differences.why: inventory A1, section 3.2; recipe step 5; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): choose-one, or a when and a where
